q: What is Qortal?
a: Qortal is a fully decentralized blockchain and peer-to-peer data network: infrastructure for a parallel internet. People run their own nodes, earn QORT by minting, and publish websites, Q-Apps, files and media on QDN, the Qortal Data Network. Q-Chat, Q-Mail and Torq carry messages and social posts. There was no ICO and no company owns the network. For a guided start, open the Welcome to Qortal Q-App.

q: Is Qortal a video game?
aliases: is Qortal like a Discord game
a: No. Qortal is a fully decentralized blockchain and peer-to-peer data network. People run nodes, mint QORT by contributing, and publish on QDN. Levels are on-chain minting contribution levels.

q: What is the native coin of Qortal?
a: The native coin is QORT. It pays transaction fees (about 0.01 QORT each) and the one-time name registration fee, it is earned by minting (helping secure the network), and it can be traded peer-to-peer in Q-Trade for LTC, BTC, DOGE, RVN, DGB and ARRR. New QORT is created only by minting: there was no ICO and no pre-mine for early investors.

q: When was Qortal Genesis?
a: Qortal mainnet Genesis — the first block — was minted on June 29, 2020. That is the network's birthday. Qortal was written from scratch after earlier work on QORA; Genesis started with nothing pre-mined for a privileged sale.

q: What is minting on Qortal?
a: On Qortal, minting replaces mining. Accounts with minting rights run a full node that stays online, and every online minter shares in each block's reward. Your share grows with your level, which rises with time spent minting. Expensive hardware gives no advantage: a modest always-on machine, even a Raspberry Pi-class board, is enough. The rule is one minting account per person.

q: How do I become a minter?

a:
1. Register a Qortal name and keep a little QORT for fees.
2. Run a full node in Qortal Hub that stays synced and online.
3. Use Qortal visibly for a while: publish on QDN, use Q-Mail and Q-Chat, help others.
4. A Level 5+ minter who knows your work nominates you in Q-Mintership (you cannot nominate yourself).

q: What are Qortal levels?
a: Levels are on-chain account levels from 0 to 10 that come from minting, not game scores. Level 0 is the waiting room, with no reward share. Level 1 (Initiation) comes after about 7,200 online blocks. Level 5, a little over a year of steady minting, lets you nominate new minters. Level 10 (Maturity) takes about eight years. Higher levels earn a larger share of each block reward and more voting weight.

Write the seed phrase on paper, keep the backup file offline, never screenshot either into cloud photos, and never share them.

q: What is QDN?
aliases: what is the Qortal Data Network

a: QDN (Qortal Data Network) is Qortal's decentralized data layer. Every resource is identified by a registered name, a service type (e.g. WEBSITE, APP, DOCUMENT, FILE), and an optional identifier; a new publish with the same three replaces the old one. Nodes that follow a name store and serve that name's data. Large payloads are stored off-chain and verified by an on-chain SHA-256 hash; tiny payloads under 240 bytes can live fully on-chain.

Identity is your wallet address plus optional registered name.

QORT trades directly for LTC, BTC, DOGE, RVN, DGB and ARRR using AT (Automated Transaction) contracts on the Qortal chain, with no exchange company holding your coins. q: What is a default QDN resource?

q: Are private QDN resources possible?

q: What size limits should I know for QDN?

Hub and GO accept files up to 2 GB each when you publish through your own node, and up to 500 MB through a public node. Large files suit the FILE service rather than DOCUMENT.

q: How does the new nomination system work?

Nomination is how minting rights are granted today; it replaced sponsorship.

3. About 40% Minter Admin yes votes unlock the admin actions.
4. An admin creates a MINTER group invite, which needs signatures from about 40% of the Minter Admins to become active.
5. You accept with JOIN_GROUP, start minting from Minting in Qortal Hub (the sprout icon), and keep a synced full node online.
